main_text.p: parte RegisFræciæ repēte ad portas ciuitatis Ana-gninę,in quā Papa confugerat pro tutela:quia ibi-dem natus fuerat. Inuenietes igitur portas apertas ingresi sunt ciuitate,& mox dederūt insultū Pala-tio domini Papæ.Cōmunitas vero villæ cōperto, cp VVillelmus de Lōgarecto(legēdū estNogaret-to)senefchallus RegisFræcię aduenifset,vt Papā de poneret vel necaret, statim pulsata cōmuni cāpa-na,& tractatu habito,elegerūt sibi capitaneū quē-dāAdnulphū,qui quidē ill s ignorātibus extitit do-mini Papæ capitalis inimicus.Hi omnes cōmuni-bus votis tantū irruerūt in Papā, & nepotē suū, & tres Cārdinales(q a tergo per latrinā euaserunt) cp diu(vt putabatur)eis resistere non valerent.Ob quā caussam Dominus Papa timēs sibi,treugas petiit. Quib' finitis, exercitus per vim ad Papā est ingref sus: quē tūc permulti verbis cōtumeliōsis sunt ag-gressi. Cū aūt ad rationē positus esset,an vellet re-nuntiare Papatui,cōstāter respōdit.Nō:imō citius vellet perdere caput suū,dicēs in suo vulgari Ecco il colo:Ecco il capo:quōd est dicere,Ecce collū,Ecce caput.Et statim ptestatus est cora omnibus,quōd Papatui nunquā renūtiaret, quādiu posset habere vitā, exercit' verò postquā irrupit palatiū,mox de spoliauit Papā,& eius camerā,atq; thefauraria suā, & asportauit vestimenta cum ornamentis,& au-rum atque argentum,cū omnibus aliis rebus inuē tis ibidem.Et reuera creditur, quod omnes reges mundi non possent tantum de thefauro reddere, infrā vnum annum, quantum fuit de papali pala-tio asportatum.Remansit autem papa sub custodia militum & custodum vsque ad diem tertiā:sed po-pulus Anagū,fācta conuocatione secreta vsque ad decem

page.notes: Printed text is in a mixed set of letters with many long s forms rendered as plain s. Marginal references and small marks such as "cp" and "q" are kept as printed. Several words in the lower lines are slightly blurred near the fold and the bottom edge; no words were marked [?] because the reading is clear enough. The two lines at the foot ("decem") appear to be part of the final running sentence. Passage contains a few possible printing errors left as printed (e.g. "valerent", "ptestatus", "Hi omnes").
